label_coverage_diagnostic.interpretation: All real plates require at least one class without positive training exposure at that head; this does not imply mathematically impossible predictions

observations: Spatial features strongly improve synthetic candidate recall with the same parameter count
The matched U-Net did not improve the stronger spatial model overall in this single run
All three models have zero complete-plate recall at budgets 5/10/50 on this real benchmark
This benchmark differs in format and font from the synthetic training distribution
Public benchmark feedback is exploratory; the user camera data remains an independent evidence gate
limitations: One seed, one original synthetic font and format
Upstream benchmark labels are not independently verified human transcriptions
Real crops come from annotation boxes, not the user-trained YOLO
One eight-character label is explicitly excluded; current capacity remains seven
No source-session metadata; entire public source is held out from training and calibration
Transferred source calibration does not establish calibrated real-domain confidence
Actual user YOLO weights and GPU behavior remain unverified

degradation_protocol.original_condition: Source crop without additional evaluation corruption; this does not mean a readable video reference frame
degradation_protocol.corrupted_conditions: Synthetic defocus, motion, downsampling, JPEG and crop transformations applied to source images
